new.title: Refund and Cancellation Policy - Bengaluru City Corporations Property Tax Online Payment Services
new.notes: Jurisdiction: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Agency name as displayed: Bengaluru City Corporations. The official two-page PDF returned HTTP 200 and displayed no publication or revision date; currentness is limited to retrieval on 2026-09-06. Wayback Save Page Now was attempted for this exact PDF on 2026-09-06 and timed out after 30 seconds with zero response bytes; no snapshot URL was confirmed. The original official URL is retained without substitution.

data.reason: Add the official refund-policy PDF containing the explicit zero municipal service fee.

new.text: For online property-tax payment, the City Corporation charges no additional service fee beyond statutory property tax.
new.notes: This explicit zero applies only to a City Corporation-added service fee. It does not establish that the transaction is free of bank or gateway charges; statutory property tax is outside the fee question.

data.reason: Add the actionable explicit-zero fee claim for the primary scenario.

new.text: The official refund policy says bank or payment-gateway charges, if any, are non-refundable.
new.notes: The policy gives no amount, percentage, mode matrix, or rule showing whether such a charge applies before payment. This claim does not independently support a stated cost value.

data.reason: Add the atomic limitation accompanying the explicit zero municipal fee.
